lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: A hundred winters ago, the lake had no name,|and the north had one keeper.
lines.text: A hundred winters ago, the lake had no name, and the north had one keeper.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Keep this cold, Torvald.|Keep it until I come back for it.
lines.text: Keep this cold, Torvald. Keep it until I come back for it.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: What is it?
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: A promise I made to a stone.|Something will come for it. Every winter.
lines.text: A promise I made to a stone. Something will come for it. Every winter.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: My lord? The ice is singing. Can you hear it?
lines.text: My lord? The ice is singing. Can you hear it?

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Go home, girl. Winter is coming,|and it is bringing guests.
lines.text: Go home, girl. Winter is coming, and it is bringing guests.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: This is my home. I'll stay,|if it's all the same to you.
lines.text: This is my home. I'll stay, if it's all the same to you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The first winter came down from the|north, and it did not come alone.
lines.text: The first winter came down from the north, and it did not come alone.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: That is my key, frost-man.|I made the lock. Give it back.
lines.text: That is my key, frost-man. I made the lock. Give it back.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: A talking stone. Wonderful.|I was hoping for a quiet century.
lines.text: A talking stone. Wonderful. I was hoping for a quiet century.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: The ice holds for us, and not|for them. Remember that, girl.
lines.text: The ice holds for us, and not for them. Remember that, girl.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Aldra. My name is Aldra. And I will remember.
lines.text: Aldra. My name is Aldra. And I will remember.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Spring came late to the lake,|and stayed only a little while.
lines.text: Spring came late to the lake, and stayed only a little while.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Wake. We have guests.
lines.text: Wake. We have guests.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: You carved a giant out of my lake.
lines.text: You carved a giant out of my lake.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: You weren't using it.
lines.text: You weren't using it.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Every winter, frost-man.|I have nothing left but winters.
lines.text: Every winter, frost-man. I have nothing left but winters.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Bigger ones. Of course there are bigger ones.
lines.text: Bigger ones. Of course there are bigger ones.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The third winter was the longest.|The Hollow sent everything it had left.
lines.text: The third winter was the longest. The Hollow sent everything it had left.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Step aside, little king of snow.|I built stairs before your mountains had names.
lines.text: Step aside, little king of snow. I built stairs before your mountains had names.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Stone is patient. Ice is older.
lines.text: Stone is patient. Ice is older.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Three winters, and not one|stone stood on your ice.
lines.text: Three winters, and not one stone stood on your ice.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: They will come back.
lines.text: They will come back.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Then so will you. Every winter.|You are my patience, Torvald.
lines.text: Then so will you. Every winter. You are my patience, Torvald.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Aldra Stillwater. Stay with it.|The ice keeps its wardens.
lines.text: Aldra Stillwater. Stay with it. The ice keeps its wardens.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Then I will keep it right back.
lines.text: Then I will keep it right back.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The lake froze around the Heartfrost that night.|It did not thaw for a hundred winters.
lines.text: The lake froze around the Heartfrost that night. It did not thaw for a hundred winters.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Too slow... forgive me. Too slow.
lines.text: Too slow... forgive me. Too slow.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: Cracked. Not broken.
lines.text: Cracked. Not broken.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.subtitle: The longhouse... my mother's nets were in there.
lines.text: The longhouse... my mother's nets were in there.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Mine. At last, mine.
lines.text: Mine. At last, mine.
